interval_convention: Half-open [first native opening fill,last native flat fill), clipped to [2024-09-01,2026-09-01) UTC; simultaneous closes/opens have zero duration
standalone_time_interpretation: BTC flat is maximum baseline clock-time opportunity for a standalone SOL mode, not number of causal signals, eligible entry capacity, executable trades or profitable hours. Existing SOL may already occupy some of it. BOTH_FLAT is time with neither baseline leg held. Alternative H4 actions change future occupancy.
role_priority_proposal: Root proposed BTC-open hedge override; BTC-flat standalone SOL. This requires explicit native role transition/ownership, not implementation approval.
incompatibility: Independent SOL TP reductions/flat exits conflict with continuous full-BTC hedge coverage: own TP reduces coverage unless hedge replenishes, while replenishment overrides standalone exit and changes turnover/rights. Choose explicit mode/priority; cannot promise both without changed policy.
restrictions: No quantity/PnL/fees/market read, model, engine or threshold scan; no source changes; final metadata stop.
